messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Turkish, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Turkish line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|--------------------|------------------------|--------| | In | preposition “in” (locative) – “in every part” | *(none – expressed by the suffix ‑da on “parçalarda”)* | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | tutte | adjective “all” | Tüm | all | OK | | parti | noun “parts” (plural) | parçalar (in **parçalarda**) | parts | OK | | impera | verb “governs” | hüküm sürer | governs | OK | | e | conjunction “and” | ve | and | OK | | quivi *(line 127)* | adverb “there” (locative for the second predicate) | orada | there | OK | | regge | verb “reigns” | yönetir | reigns | OK | | quivi *(line 128)* | adverb “there” (locative for existence) | Orada | there | OK | | è | verb “is” (copular) | vardır | is / exists | OK | | la | definite article “the” | *(none – Turkish omits articles)* | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | sua | possessive adjective “His” | onun | his | OK | | città | noun “city” | şehri | city | OK | | e *(line 128)* | conjunction “and” | ve | and | OK | | l'alto | adjective “lofty” | yüksek | lofty | OK | | seggio | noun “seat” | makamı | seat | OK | | oh | interjection “O” | Ah | O | OK | | felice | adjective “happy” | mutlu | happy | OK | | colui | pronoun “he” (the one) | o | he | OK | | cu' | relative pronoun “whom” | *(none – incorporated in the participial phrase “seçilen”)* | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | ivi | adverb “there / thereto” | orada | there | OK | | elegge | verb “elects” | seçilen | elected (participle) | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: *In*, *la*, *cu'* – Turkish does not need separate words for these functions; the meaning is conveyed by case suffixes or is implicit in the participial construction. - **WRONG / MISSING / GRAMMAR**: none.
All other source items are adequately rendered in the Turkish translation.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Turkish script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Turkish text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 127: - Original: Tüm parçalarda hüküm sürer ve orada yönetir; - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - Line 128: - Original: Orada onun şehri ve yüksek makamı vardır: - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - Line 129: - Original: Ah mutlu o, orada seçilen! - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
